scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @copilotmail/design-system && npm run build --workspace @copilotmail/admin-app && npm run build --workspace @copilotmail/mail-app && npm run bundle:check
scripts.bundle:check:admin: npm run bundle:check:self-test && node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs --application admin-app
scripts.bundle:check:mail: npm run bundle:check:self-test && node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs --application mail-app
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @copilotmail/design-system && npm run check --workspace @copilotmail/admin-app && npm run check --workspace @copilotmail/mail-app
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @copilotmail/design-system && npm run test --workspace @copilotmail/admin-app && npm run test --workspace @copilotmail/mail-app
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test --workspace @copilotmail/design-system -- --coverage --maxWorkers=1 && npm run test --workspace @copilotmail/admin-app -- --coverage --maxWorkers=1 && npm run test --workspace @copilotmail/mail-app -- --coverage --maxWorkers=1 && node scripts/summarize-coverage.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e:run
scripts.e2e:update: npm run build && npm run e2e:check && playwright test --update-snapshots
